lee_oncall: Heads-up — hosted-integ smoke is red on shard 12. Failing combos: auth handshake + streaming tool-call + payload schema errors. @sam_dev @jane_d can you take a look?

ci-bot: CI summary — job=hosted_integ_smoke shard=12 status=FAILED  tests=48/120 passed  failures=72  flaky=3  fail-reasons=[401, 502, schema_error] see: https://ci.redwood/integrations/26745

sam_dev: on it. pulling logs now, will check auth logs first.

jane_d: I just glanced at the last green -> red window, 3 merges in last 2 hours: PRs #4521 (auth:token-rotate), #4523 (streaming:batching), #4524 (toolcall:response-schema). Suggest rerun shard once to confirm reproducibility before a full bisect.

lee_oncall: agreed. can someone trigger a scheduled rerun on shard 12 and shard 8 (seen some sporadic errors there too)?

deploy-bot: scheduled rerun queued: testrunner rerun --job=hosted_integ_smoke --shards=8,12 --priority=high --triggered-by=lee_oncall (run_id=rerun-2674500012) :white_check_mark: 

sam_dev: quick paste from the host log that looks suspicious:
```
2026-02-17T13:02:11Z ERROR auth: token validation failed: JWT kid mismatch (expected kid=0x9a3b, got kid=0x2f1c)
2026-02-17T13:02:11Z WARN stream: toolcall connection aborted, upstream returned 502
2026-02-17T13:02:11Z ERROR schema: tool_response missing required field: "name"
```

priya_ml: wow — kid mismatch + schema missing name. The token-rotate PR touches kid selection; could be a new key published but older workers still using cache. Also streaming 502 might be fallout when auth fails mid-handshake.

jane_d: if auth is the root cause, rerun with token cache disabled for the workers on shard 12 to force fresh fetch? I can push a quick test config:
```
envvars:
  REDWOOD_AUTH_CACHE_TTL: 0
```

sam_dev: that sounds reasonable. I'll spin a one-off rerun with that env override on shard 12 (non-blocking): testrunner rerun --job=hosted_integ_smoke --shards=12 --env REDWOOD_AUTH_CACHE_TTL=0 --note "test token cache TTL=0"

ci-bot: rerun started (run_id=rerun-2674500056). Keep an eye on logs: https://ci.redwood/integrations/26745/rerun-2674500056

lee_oncall: if the cache TTL trick fixes auth but schema still fails, then we need to look at PR #4524 for the tool response shape. Sam, can you also grab the raw payload from the failed toolcall and paste it here?

sam_dev: pasted the truncated payload below — it was returned by the tool proxy before the streaming layer blew up:
```
{"id": "tool-run-9a1", "output": {"status":"ok","result":{"text":"..."}}}
```
Note: no "name" field at top-level of tool result — matches schema error.

jane_d: PR #4524 updated the serializer for tool runs; looks like it changed where name gets emitted. I'll open a hotfix PR to restore the shape if rerun confirms.

priya_ml: also, for bisecting: if rerun with cache TTL=0 still shows failures across multiple shards, we should bisect across merges in the last 4 hours. Candidate merges: #4521, #4523, #4524.

lee_oncall: agreed. if rerun-2674500056 still fails, next step: 1) request bisect job on the window 4h 2) tag oncall with the bisect results 3) block release if regression confirmed.

ci-bot: rerun-2674500056 finished: status=FAILED. Summary: shard=12 failures remain: auth=1 (401), schema=4, stream-timeout=2. Full logs: https://ci.redwood/integrations/26745/rerun-2674500056/logs

sam_dev: rerun kept failing. with token cache disabled we still see schema and stream errors. grabbing bisect now across PRs #4521..#4524. starting binary search on integrations pipeline.

jane_d: ping me when bisect job is queued — I can prep a tiny revert for #4524 if the bisect points there.

sam_dev: bisect job queued (job_id=bisect-2674500099). will update when we have a candidate commit.

lee_oncall: thanks everyone. quick ops note: if we find the schema change is intentional we need to coordinate with SDK teams before force-reverting. low-latency mitigation: add a compatibility shim in the proxy to accept both shapes for now.

priya_ml: agree — fallback shim is safest short-term. I can author a small patch to proxy that maps {output: {result: {...}}} -> {name: "unnamed", ...} if name missing.

sam_dev: bisect finished early — culprit: PR #4524 (toolcall:response-schema) merged at 2026-02-17T11:58. Reproduces deterministically on shard 12 in the current CI image.

jane_d: opening hotfix PR now with restore of old serializer shape + compatibility shim: https://git.redwood/pr/4526 — will request urgent review.

lee_oncall: awesome. once #4526 is merged, let's schedule a full smoke run across all shards and keep an eye for any residual auth oddities.

deploy-bot: hotfix PR merged and rolled to canary. Canary smoke run queued (run_id=canary-2674500145).

ci-bot: canary-2674500145 results — shard 12: PASSED, shard 8: flaky (1 test failed, auto-requeued), overall: partial green.

lee_oncall: moving to monitor mode. big thanks all — great triage. :tada:
